Text: Good work out there, <NAME>.
Now for your report, if you please.
Right, commencing report.
We successfully rescued Kiku of the Rose Division.
It seems like he found the sword of the Pandemonium Regalia...
But it was then taken by someone, or something.
I see... So the Regalia have been taken...
Plus, the much of the interior of the Mikasa has been frozen over.
It’s just been one strange thing after another.

Understood.
Well done rescuing Kiku.
<NAME>, go get some rest and remain on standby for your next orders.
